_README: Registry of every gated claim in Parts I-VI, with the provenance needed to
defend or retract it. thesis/run_stats.py reads this and writes
thesis/stats-report.md. Edit THIS file, never the report.
per_item     a per-item record survives and was opened; b/c are real
counts_only  only the aggregate survives; a paired test is impossible
unless b/c can be bounded from the marginals
missing      no data; goes to the re-run backlog and is NOT defended
n_effective is the number of INDEPENDENT observations, always <= n_rows.
Deterministic reps, two phrase legs over one render, and two cells cut from
one video all collapse. The independence_note says which applies.
gate_p is the pre-registered gate expressed as a rate, so a one-sided exact
binomial can ask whether the observed count beats it as a probability rather

claims.headline: Zero-shot SmolVLM cannot ground at all: 256M parses 0/50, 500M parses 2/50, neither lands a box
claims.independence_note: 50 items over 47 unique images (3 images appear twice), 49 unique expressions
claims.caveats: Ambos brazos están clavados en el suelo con 0 aciertos, de modo que una prueba pareada entre ellos es degenerada (b=c=0). El intervalo de Wilson sobre 0/50 es todo el contenido: [0, 0.071]. Eso basta para justificar el abandono del spine y es la forma correcta de enunciarlo.
claims.caveats_en: Both arms are floor-pinned at 0 successes, so a paired test between them is degenerate (b=c=0). The Wilson interval on 0/50 is the whole content: [0, 0.071]. That is enough to justify abandoning the spine and is the correct way to state it.

claims.headline: Stage-2 fine-tune collapses: 2/200 at IoU@0.25 against a 30% gate
claims.independence_note: 200 items capped from the RefDrone/VisDrone val pool; image-level clustering not measurable from the surviving file
claims.caveats: 2/200 frente a un umbral del 30% queda tan por debajo que ninguna corrección por agrupamiento podría cambiar el veredicto. El DIAGNÓSTICO de 'mode collapse', en cambio, se apoya en 5 predicciones inspeccionadas a mano y no es en sí mismo una afirmación medida.
claims.caveats_en: 2/200 against a 30% gate is so far below that no clustering correction could change the verdict. The 'mode collapse' DIAGNOSIS, however, rests on 5 hand-inspected predictions and is not itself a measured claim.

claims.headline: GGUF export costs 23-30 pp of grounding accuracy against a 5 pp fidelity gate
claims.independence_note: 100 distinct RefCOCO val caption-box pairs, seed-42 shuffle. RefCOCO can repeat images but the jsonl stores no image id, so clustering is unmeasurable here.
claims.caveats: El brazo HF NO tiene fichero por ítem, así que b y c no son directamente recuperables. En su lugar están ACOTADOS: las marginales fijan b - c = 30, lo que deja c en [0, 15]. El PEOR caso para la significación es c=15, b=45, y aun así da p = 1.3e-04. Los b/c almacenados aquí son ese peor caso, de modo que el valor p reportado es una cota superior y la catástrofe es significativa bajo todo emparejamiento compatible con los datos. Este es el resultado individual más fuerte de la Parte I.
claims.caveats_en: The HF arm has NO per-item file, so b and c are not directly recoverable. They are BOUNDED instead: the marginals fix b - c = 30, which leaves c in [0, 15]. The WORST case for significance is c=15, b=45, and that still gives p = 1.3e-04. The b/c stored here are that worst case, so the reported p is an upper bound and the catastrophe is significant under every pairing consistent with the data. This is the strongest single result in Part I.

claims.headline: F16 62/100 vs Q8_0 55/100: the 7 pp quantisation gap is NOT distinguishable from noise
claims.verdict: reported as a further loss; not supported
claims.independence_note: same 100 RefCOCO items scored under both GGUF arms; true pairing, both per-item files survive
claims.caveats: Calculado aquí por primera vez: b=17, c=10, p=0.248. La pérdida de fidelidad está en la EXPORTACIÓN, no en la cuantización de 8 bits. Toda frase de la tesis que atribuya parte de la caída a Q8_0 debe matizarse.
claims.caveats_en: Computed here for the first time: b=17, c=10, p=0.248. The fidelity loss is in the EXPORT, not in the 8-bit quantisation. Any thesis sentence attributing part of the drop to Q8_0 must be softened.

claims.headline: A RefCOCO-tuned model transfers to aerial at 1/50
claims.independence_note: 50 items over 47 unique images, 49 unique expressions
claims.caveats: Pre-registrado como descriptivo y sin barra. El intervalo al 95% sobre 1/50 es aproximadamente [0.001, 0.106], de modo que '2.0% está en el suelo de acierto aleatorio' no es una afirmación que los datos puedan sostener — solo lo es 'como mucho en torno al 10%'.
claims.caveats_en: Pre-registered as descriptive with no bar. The 95% interval on 1/50 is roughly [0.001, 0.106], so '2.0% is at the random-guess floor' is not a statement the data can carry - only 'at most about 10%' is.

claims.headline: Stage-4 curriculum reaches 39/200 = 19.5% against a 20% gate: a ONE-ITEM miss
claims.independence_note: same 200-item val cap reused at each of the 3 epochs, so the epoch series is not 3 independent measurements
claims.caveats: La puerta más instructiva de la Parte I. 39/200 frente a un umbral de 40/200 está dentro de una sola extracción de Bernoulli, y el intervalo de Wilson al 95% [0.146, 0.257] abarca holgadamente el 20%. Los datos no pueden distinguir 'incumplida' de 'cumplida'. El NARROW MISS registrado es una decisión de ingeniería defendible y una decisión estadística indefendible; la tesis debe presentarlo como lo primero.
claims.caveats_en: The most instructive gate in Part I. 39/200 vs a 40/200 threshold is within one Bernoulli draw, and the 95% Wilson interval [0.146, 0.257] straddles 20% comfortably. The data cannot distinguish 'missed' from 'met'. The recorded NARROW MISS is a defensible engineering decision and an indefensible statistical one; the thesis must present it as the former.

claims.headline: SITL control stack holds an oracle-fed lock: 3/3 trials, 12.89 px mean error, 100% coverage
claims.independence_note: 3597 frames but only 3 trials, and the 3 trials share one programmatic trajectory (0.25 m/s constant north, re-anchored 0.5 m ahead each start). Effectively one scenario measured three times.
claims.caveats: Una puerta de capacidad, no una medición muestreada. 3/3 en un único escenario demuestra que la pila PUEDE cerrar el lazo; no dice nada sobre una tasa a lo largo de escenarios. El recuento de fotogramas no debe usarse nunca como n.
claims.caveats_en: A capability gate, not a sampled measurement. 3/3 on one scenario shows the stack CAN close the loop; it says nothing about a rate over scenarios. The frame count must never be used as n.

claims.headline: Phase C closed-loop VLM follow - RETRACTED, the camera was aimed at the sky
claims.independence_note: not applicable
claims.caveats: Existen 13 CSVs de phase-c con todas las columnas por fotograma y deliberadamente NO se extrajeron: los píxeles de entrada eran un fotograma de cielo vacío (el pitch +pi/2 de la cámara de gz es HACIA ABAJO, no hacia arriba). Extraerlos produciría números bien formados sobre nada. Este es el caso que motivó, en el propio repositorio, la regla 'look at it'.

rerun.missing: píxeles válidos — la medida es inválida en origen
rerun.cost: superado; el rig de CARLA (P6.1) es el sitio correcto para volver a preguntarlo
rerun.command: runners/run_phase_c.py con el renderizador CARLA, tras corregir el pitch de cámara

claims.caveats_en: 13 phase-c CSVs with full per-frame columns exist and were deliberately NOT extracted: the input pixels were a blank sky frame (gz camera pitch +pi/2 is DOWN, not up). Extracting them would produce well-formed numbers about nothing. This is the repo's own motivating case for the 'look at it' rule.

claims.headline: Qwen2-VL-2B base grounds 15/100 zero-shot where SmolVLM-500M grounds 0/100
claims.independence_note: RefCOCO may repeat images; the runs record no image ids so clustering is unmeasurable
claims.caveats: La decisión de spine se apoya TAMBIÉN en una comparación de fidelidad de exportación de -2 pp (Qwen) frente a -16 pp (SmolVLM). La cifra de -2 pp es 15/100 frente a 14/100 - una diferencia de UN SOLO ítem presentada como una propiedad de fidelidad. Esa pata del argumento no está respaldada; la pata de 15/100 frente a 0/100 sí lo está.
claims.caveats_en: The spine decision ALSO rests on an export-fidelity comparison of -2 pp (Qwen) vs -16 pp (SmolVLM). The -2 pp figure is 15/100 vs 14/100 - a ONE-ITEM difference presented as a fidelity property. That leg of the argument is not supported; the 15/100 vs 0/100 leg is.

claims.headline: RefDrone is 33.2% well-posed against a 0.95 bar; only 439 of 1421 val captions carry exactly one box
claims.verdict: raw ill-posed (gate FAIL); filtered subset adopted
claims.independence_note: a census of a fixed dataset, not a sample
claims.caveats: Ninguna prueba es apropiada: esto es una enumeración completa, de modo que un intervalo de confianza sería un error de categoría. Su peso inferencial está aguas abajo: estos mismos 439 son el conjunto de evaluación de TODOS los números de la Parte II, y por eso la agrupación de las 316 imágenes únicas se propaga por toda la parte.
claims.caveats_en: No test is appropriate: this is a complete enumeration, so a confidence interval would be a category error. Its inferential weight is downstream - this same 439 is the evaluation set for EVERY Part II number, which is why the 316-unique-images clustering propagates through the whole part.

claims.headline: Pre-training aerial gate cleared at max_side=1024: 133/439 = 30.3% against a 20% bar
claims.independence_note: 439 captions over 316 unique images (85 images x2, 19 x3). The 4-arm ladder is scored on the SAME items, so the arms are strongly dependent and any pairwise comparison must be paired.
claims.caveats: El umbral se supera con un margen amplio, de modo que el agrupamiento por imagen no amenaza el veredicto. El 'codo' de RQ-2.3 no tiene barra numérica y es un juicio a ojo — debe presentarse como una decisión de diseño, no como un hallazgo.
claims.caveats_en: The gate clears with a wide margin, so the image clustering does not threaten the verdict. The 'elbow' in RQ-2.3 has no numeric bar and is an eyeballed judgement - it should be presented as a design choice, not a finding.

claims.headline: LoRA fine-tune reaches 261/439 = 59.5% against a 20% gate
claims.independence_note: same 439-over-316-images clustering. The in-loop n=200 epoch evals are a SUBSET of the same items reused each epoch, so 0.63/0.65/0.65 are three overlapping measurements on a changing model, not three samples.
claims.caveats: 261 es el único entero compatible con el 0.595 redondeado y está corroborado por el gate_hits acumulado del log de evaluación (260 en i=435). El margen sobre la puerta es enorme; el agrupamiento no puede alterar el veredicto.
claims.caveats_en: 261 is the only integer consistent with the rounded 0.595 and is corroborated by the eval log's running gate_hits (260 at i=435). Margin over the gate is enormous; clustering cannot touch the verdict.

claims.headline: Deployed Q8_0 on the Jetson reaches 275/439 = 62.6% against a 57.5% fidelity budget - the Part I catastrophe is eliminated
claims.independence_note: same 439-over-316-images clustering as the rest of Part II
claims.caveats: El número estrella de la Parte II. Los brazos de runtime (F16 273, Q8_0 275) quedan POR ENCIMA de la referencia HF (261), lo que el registro interpreta como una victoria de fidelidad; con estos marginales, esa diferencia de 14 ítems está dentro de lo que el emparejamiento podría producir por azar, de modo que la afirmación defendible es «no hay pérdida medible en la exportación», no «la exportación la mejoró».
claims.caveats_en: The headline Part II number. The runtime arms (F16 273, Q8_0 275) sit ABOVE the HF reference (261), which the ledger reads as a fidelity win; on these marginals that 14-item difference is within what the pairing could produce by chance, so the defensible claim is 'no measurable export loss', not 'the export improved it'.

claims.headline: Whole-frame accuracy knees at max_side=1024: 63.1% vs 31.4% at 512
claims.verdict: 1024 is the knee; 4.4 s per anchor is too slow for the 2 s budget
claims.independence_note: 439 samples over 316 unique images; all arms share one sample draw
claims.caveats: No se pre-registró ningún umbral numérico — un barrido de caracterización cuya función era establecer la línea base contra la que se mide la palanca ROI. Cuatro ejecuciones SMOKE de n=6 están en el mismo directorio runs/ y no deben confundirse con los brazos de n=439.
claims.caveats_en: No numeric gate was pre-registered - a characterisation sweep whose job was to establish the baseline the ROI lever is measured against. Four n=6 SMOKE runs sit in the same runs/ directory and must not be confused with the n=439 arms.

claims.headline: ROI re-anchor at M=2.0 @512 reaches 374/439 = 85.2% against the 62.6% deployed baseline, at 2.7x cheaper prefill
claims.independence_note: 439 samples over 316 unique images. All 15 grid cells were scored on ONE sample draw, so cell-to-cell differences are correlated and the peak's location is less certain than the grid suggests.
claims.caveats: Los recuentos se reconstruyeron a partir de las tasas almacenadas y caen exactamente en enteros, así que son exactos. La puerta se supera con un margen enorme y sobrevive a cualquier corrección por agrupamiento plausible. La SELECCIÓN de M=2.0 @512 como pico frente a M=1.5 @512 (368/439) es una diferencia de 6 ítems sobre ítems compartidos y debe presentarse como 'una meseta, y tomamos un punto sobre ella'.
claims.caveats_en: Counts were reconstructed from stored rates and land exactly on integers, so they are exact. The gate is cleared with a huge margin and survives any plausible clustering correction. The SELECTION of M=2.0 @512 as the peak over M=1.5 @512 (368/439) is a 6-item difference on shared items and should be presented as 'a plateau, we took a point on it'.

claims.headline: The ROI crop tolerates anchor drift: 326-367/439 across shift levels 0.25-1.0
claims.independence_note: same clustering, plus: the perturbation is a SINGLE seeded draw per sample per level. There is one realisation of the drift, not a distribution over drift directions.
claims.caveats: Sin barra numérica pre-registrada. Como la dirección de la deriva es una sola extracción, los números por nivel de desplazamiento arrastran error muestral en la PERTURBACIÓN además de en los ítems, y solo el primero está cuantificado. El peor nivel (1.0, M=2.0) sigue superando la línea base del 62.6%, que es la forma honesta de la afirmación.
claims.caveats_en: No pre-registered numeric bar. Because the drift direction is one draw, the shift-level numbers carry sampling error in the PERTURBATION as well as in the items, and only the first is quantified. Worst level (1.0, M=2.0) still clears the 62.6% baseline, which is the honest form of the claim.

claims.headline: Learned SR (Swin2SR) does NOT beat free interpolation on the ROI crop: 337/429 vs lanczos 344/429
claims.independence_note: 429 samples over 312 unique images (211 with 1 caption, 85 with 2, 16 with 3). Two expressions over one aerial frame share scene, object density and JPEG degradation.
claims.caveats: CORRIGE UNA CONCLUSIÓN YA REGISTRADA. Los pares discordantes se calculan aquí por primera vez: lanczos vs swin2sr b=21 c=14 p=0.31; bicubic vs swin2sr b=22 c=12 p=0.12; bicubic vs native p=0.26. NINGUNA diferencia de exactitud en este sondeo es significativa. El rechazo es correcto, pero debe justificarse por LATENCIA (+1331 ms por recorte, determinista y enorme), no por exactitud. Cualquier frase que diga que Swin2SR 'pierde' en IoU carece de respaldo; la frase respaldada es que no aporta nada medible a cambio de 1.3 s.
claims.caveats_en: CORRECTS A RECORDED CONCLUSION. Discordants computed here for the first time: lanczos vs swin2sr b=21 c=14 p=0.31; bicubic vs swin2sr b=22 c=12 p=0.12; bicubic vs native p=0.26. NO accuracy difference in this probe is significant. The rejection is correct but must be justified on LATENCY (+1331 ms per crop, deterministic and enormous), not on accuracy. Any sentence saying Swin2SR 'loses' on IoU is unsupported; the supported sentence is that it buys nothing measurable for 1.3 s.

claims.headline: Carry at 768 px scores 0.830 mean per-track IoU@0.25 vs 0.849 at 1024, inside a 5 pp bar
claims.verdict: OP=768 adopted by the frozen rule
claims.independence_note: 186 tracks from exactly 93 sequences, 2 tracks per sequence with no exceptions. Two tracks from one clip share flight, altitude and lighting. n_effective is 93.
claims.caveats: Una prueba de signos sobre la comparación pareada por track: 1024 gana a 768 en 55 tracks, 768 gana a 1024 en 31, 100 empates. p exacto = 0.014, así que 1024 SÍ es significativamente más preciso que 768. La adopción de 768 nunca fue una afirmación de igualdad - la regla congelada era un listón de TAMAÑO DEL EFECTO (dentro de 5 pp de la referencia de 1024) más una restricción de FPS. La tesis debe enunciarlo así: se eligió 768 pese a un coste de precisión real, pequeño y detectable.
claims.caveats_en: A sign test on the per-track paired comparison: 1024 beats 768 on 55 tracks, 768 beats 1024 on 31, 100 ties. Exact p = 0.014, so 1024 IS significantly more accurate than 768. The adoption of 768 was never a claim of equality - the frozen rule was an EFFECT-SIZE bar (within 5 pp of the 1024 reference) plus an FPS constraint. The thesis must state it that way: 768 was chosen despite a real, small, detectable accuracy cost.

claims.headline: TensorRT fp16 lifts the co-resident carry rate 4.89 -> 6.15 FPS against a 5 FPS gate
claims.independence_note: exactly ONE benchmark run per configuration; the per-frame latency arrays were not saved, only p50
claims.caveats: No hay intervalo calculable y no debe citarse ninguno. Los fotogramas de una misma sesión comparten el estado térmico y el estado del gobernador de reloj. La afirmación es defendible como demostración de capacidad en este dispositivo y en esta sesión, que es lo que necesita una tesis de despliegue en el borde; no es defendible como tasa esperada.
claims.caveats_en: No interval is computable and none should be quoted. Frames inside one session share thermal state and clock governor state. The claim is defensible as a capability demonstration on this device in this session, which is what an edge-deployment thesis needs; it is not defensible as an expected rate.

claims.headline: TensorRT mask parity vs eager is 1.000 IoU, max abs diff 3.09e-04
claims.independence_note: ONE track (M0205, tid 20) over ONE ~100-frame window. Boxes move ~1 px per frame; the frames are almost perfectly autocorrelated. n_effective is 1 track, not 100 frames.
claims.caveats: Una comprobación de equivalencia numérica, no una afirmación de exactitud muestreada, y es el tipo de evidencia adecuado para lo que se le pide mostrar: la exportación a fp16 no cambió la aritmética. Citar '100 fotogramas' como n sería pseudo-replicación de la clase más evidente.
claims.caveats_en: A numerical-equivalence check, not a sampled accuracy claim, and it is the right kind of evidence for what it is asked to show: fp16 export did not change the arithmetic. Quoting '100 frames' as n would be pseudo-replication of the clearest kind.

claims.headline: Memoryless baseline on the crossing-occlusion clip: 1 ID switch, 0.725 purity, 67.7 px following error
claims.independence_note: 2 clips, but one is a deliberate CONTROL at ceiling by design and one is the deliberate STRESS case. They are hand-authored, not sampled.
claims.caveats: No se pre-registró ningún umbral; T1 fue un entregable de harness. Sus números son la referencia contra la que se compara el brazo de re-ID, y solo UNO de los dos clips puede discriminar en absoluto.
claims.caveats_en: No threshold was pre-registered; T1 was a harness deliverable. Its numbers are the reference the re-ID arm is compared against, and only ONE of the two clips can discriminate at all.

claims.headline: Re-ID drives ID switches 1 -> 0 and purity 0.725 -> 1.000 on the crossing clip
claims.independence_note: one discriminating clip; the control is at ceiling in every arm by design
claims.caveats: NO HAY FICHERO CRUDO EN DISCO: los números solo sobreviven en el README y en el registro. Incluso si se recuperaran, todo el PASS descansa sobre un único clip guionizado en el que un cambio de ID ocurre o no ocurre: una sola extracción de Bernoulli, sin intervalo, sin prueba.

rerun.missing: puntuaciones por clip; solo sobrevive la prosa del README
rerun.cost: ~1 h en la 3090; los clips y el scorer están versionados

claims.caveats_en: NO RAW FILE ON DISK - the numbers survive only in the README and the ledger. Even if recovered, the entire PASS rests on a single scripted clip in which one ID switch either happens or does not: one Bernoulli draw, no interval, no test.

claims.headline: Re-ID lifts kinematic oracle coverage 49.2% -> 97.6% in the closed loop
claims.independence_note: each percentage is a frame fraction within ONE flight of ONE scripted scenario. In a closed loop the controller's output at t determines the pixels at t+1, so a single early divergence propagates through every later frame.
claims.caveats: EL n MÁS EXAGERADO DEL REPOSITORIO. No hay ningún archivo en disco; solo prosa del README. Las diferencias de fracción de fotogramas procedentes de vuelos únicos no deben presentarse nunca como si tuvieran error de muestreo entre vuelos.

rerun.missing: registros por vuelo; solo prosa del README
rerun.cost: ~2 h; necesita n>=10 vuelos por brazo para decir algo sobre una tasa

claims.caveats_en: THE MOST OVERSTATED n IN THE REPOSITORY. No file on disk; README prose only. Frame-fraction differences from single flights must never be reported as if they had sampling error over flights.

claims.headline: On-device anchor period is 2.26 s @512, above the 1.5 s coast horizon - so re-acquisition must be event-driven
claims.independence_note: 8 repeated timings of the same operation on the same device in one session; thermal ramp correlates successive reps. Raw per-rep arrays were not stored, only 6 summary statistics.
claims.caveats: La comparación que importa (2.26 s frente a 1.5 s) es un cociente de dos cantidades deterministas con una dispersión mín-máx de 1.3 ms sobre 8 repeticiones. No hace falta ninguna prueba ni es posible; la conclusión arquitectónica se sigue de las magnitudes.
claims.caveats_en: The comparison that matters (2.26 s vs 1.5 s) is a ratio of two deterministic quantities with a min-max spread of 1.3 ms over 8 reps. No test is needed or possible; the architectural conclusion follows from the magnitudes.

claims.headline: ByteTrack update costs 0.143 ms median against a 50 ms control budget - 350x headroom
claims.independence_note: 1180 CONSECUTIVE frames in one session. Update cost depends on live-track count, which is strongly autocorrelated frame to frame.
claims.caveats: Pseudorreplicación que no importa: la afirmación supera su presupuesto por dos órdenes de magnitud, de modo que ninguna corrección por dependencia podría invertirla. Vale la pena declararlo explícitamente en lugar de citar n=1180 en silencio.
claims.caveats_en: Pseudo-replication that does not matter: the claim clears its budget by two orders of magnitude, so no dependence correction could reverse it. Worth stating explicitly rather than silently quoting n=1180.

claims.headline: The 4.85 s cold acquire lands stale on moving targets: A 1/6 vs the B oracle 6/6
claims.independence_note: n=2 reps are deterministic - genuine_lock is identical in all 43 r1/r2 pairs across the whole arc, t_lock differs by <=0.02 s. 12 rows, 6 observations.
claims.caveats: EL NÚMERO QUE LANZÓ LA PARTE V, y se queda en p = 0.0625 — justo fuera de alfa, porque con n=6 hacen falta LOS SEIS pares para volcar y solo volcaron cinco. El efecto es casi con seguridad real (el mecanismo es un retardo de entrega medido de 4.85 s, no un lanzamiento de moneda), pero el EXPERIMENTO no pudo certificarlo. Seis clips eran un clip de menos.
claims.caveats_en: THE NUMBER THAT LAUNCHED PART V, and it lands at p = 0.0625 - just outside alpha, because n=6 needs ALL SIX pairs to flip and only five did. The effect is almost certainly real (the mechanism is a measured 4.85 s delivery lag, not a coin flip) but the EXPERIMENT could not certify it. Six clips was one clip too few.

claims.headline: Cold acquire scores 1/6 against a pre-registered 4/6 gate
claims.independence_note: deterministic reps collapse 12 rows to 6
claims.caveats: La dirección del fallo es lo que un diseño de 6 ítems SÍ puede establecer: 1/6 frente a una tasa de 2/3 tiene un p unilateral de 0.10. Sigue sin llegar a alpha, pero la brecha descriptiva es grande y el mecanismo se comprende.
claims.caveats_en: The failure direction is what a 6-item design CAN establish: 1/6 against a 2/3 rate has a one-sided p of 0.10. Still not alpha, but the descriptive gap is large and the mechanism is understood.

claims.headline: An operator-phrase crop hint lifts acquire to 3/6 and cuts latency 4.84 s -> 1.83 s
claims.independence_note: deterministic reps. 'cell' and 'cellbuf' are NOT two independent arms - they share the crop geometry and differ only in buffering.
claims.caveats: Exactamente DOS pares discordantes sostienen toda la afirmación: p = 0.50. La mitad de E20 relativa a la tasa de PASS no es evidencia. La mitad relativa a la LATENCIA es otra cosa —véase E20-acquire-latency— y es esa mitad la que debe sostener la narrativa de la Parte IV.
claims.caveats_en: Exactly TWO discordant pairs carry the entire claim: p = 0.50. The PASS-rate half of E20 is not evidence. The LATENCY half is a different matter - see E20-acquire-latency - and that is the half the Part IV narrative should rest on.

claims.headline: Crop-hint acquire latency: 1.83 s median vs 4.835 s cold
claims.independence_note: acquire_s is essentially a deterministic function of crop pixel area (prefill token count): r1 and r2 agree to 0.00 s on 5 of 6 clips, and clips sharing a crop size share an identical acquire_s.
claims.caveats: Nunca debe ponerse un intervalo de confianza sobre esto. Es un modelo de coste determinista, no una muestra ruidosa, y la presentación honesta es el mecanismo (menos tokens de prefill) más las dos medianas. Una reducción de latencia de 2.6x con una causa conocida no necesita valor p; afirmar uno sería falsa precisión.
claims.caveats_en: No confidence interval should ever be put on this. It is a deterministic cost model, not a noisy sample, and the honest presentation is the mechanism (fewer prefill tokens) plus the two medians. A 2.6x latency reduction with a known cause needs no p-value; claiming one would be false precision.

claims.headline: Optical-flow motion compensation reaches 2/6, buffering 1/6
claims.independence_note: deterministic reps; 12 rows, 6 observations
claims.caveats: UN solo par discordante: p = 1.0. El brazo BUF es estadísticamente vacuo frente a la línea base E18-A - b=0, c=0, McNemar indefinido. Ninguno de los dos brazos es evidencia de nada; ambos quedan correctamente registrados como fracasos en alcanzar la puerta, lo cual es una afirmación distinta y más débil que 'la compensación de movimiento no funciona'.
claims.caveats_en: ONE discordant pair: p = 1.0. The BUF arm is statistically vacuous against the E18-A baseline - b=0, c=0, McNemar undefined. Neither arm is evidence of anything; both are correctly recorded as failures to reach the gate, which is a different and weaker statement than 'motion compensation does not work'.

claims.headline: Automating the crop hint coarse-to-fine regresses to 1/6
claims.independence_note: coarse_hint is byte-identical across r1/r2 on all 6 clips
claims.caveats: Emparejado contra el brazo de celda de E20: b=2, c=0, p=0.50. El mecanismo de apoyo es más fuerte que el recuento de resultados: la propia votación gruesa de celda solo acierta 2/6, de modo que la automatización falla en un paso intermedio medible y no de forma misteriosa.
claims.caveats_en: Paired against E20's cell arm: b=2, c=0, p=0.50. The supporting mechanism is stronger than the outcome count: the coarse cell-vote itself only hits 2/6, so the automation fails at a measurable intermediate step rather than mysteriously.

claims.headline: A classical-CV prior top-1 cell hits 2/6 at t=0 and 0/6 at t=10 s, against a 4/6 proceed gate
claims.independence_note: fully deterministic offline computation, one evaluation per clip, no reps - the cleanest n in Part IV
claims.caveats: El tipo adecuado de pre-filtro barato: mató una matriz antes de ejecutarla. Las dos abstenciones en t=10 s están estructuralmente correlacionadas (mismo mecanismo de fallo), así que incluso 6 es generoso.
claims.caveats_en: The right kind of cheap pre-gate: it killed a matrix before it was run. The two t=10 s abstentions are structurally correlated (same failure mechanism), so even 6 is generous.

claims.headline: Widening the crop cell to a phrasing-tolerant width regresses to 1/6
claims.independence_note: deterministic reps on the device arm
claims.caveats: b=0, c=2 frente al brazo de celdas de E20: p=0.50. La evidencia más fuerte aquí es el barrido de contención OFFLINE - la contención en el peor caso con HW*=0.38 se mantiene en 6/6 clips y 19/19 formulaciones - que es un cálculo geométrico determinista y no necesita inferencia. La regresión en dispositivo cierra el arco; el barrido de contención explica por qué ensanchar no puede ayudar.
claims.caveats_en: b=0, c=2 against E20's cell arm: p=0.50. The stronger evidence here is the OFFLINE containment sweep - worst-case containment at HW*=0.38 holds on 6/6 clips and 19/19 phrasings - which is a deterministic geometric computation and needs no inference. The device regression closes the arc; the containment sweep explains why widening cannot help.

claims.headline: The mask-identity relock reproduces on 6/8 unseeded SITL repeats
claims.independence_note: THE BEST-DESIGNED REPLICATION IN PART IV. The harness seeds nothing; variation enters through a real-time ~20 Hz wall-clock loop, and the outcomes genuinely differ across reps rather than repeating one trajectory.
claims.caveats: La regla pre-registrada exigía 7/8 para «fiable». Esa barra es estadísticamente INALCANZABLE con n=8: incluso un 8/8 perfecto frente a una hipótesis nula de 0.875 da p = 0.34. El veredicto QUALIFIED fue la decisión correcta y el intervalo de Wilson [0.36, 0.89] es el resumen honesto: la verdadera tasa de reenganche podría estar en cualquier punto entre el lanzamiento de una moneda y la práctica certeza.
claims.caveats_en: The pre-registered rule needed 7/8 for 'reliable'. That bar is UNREACHABLE statistically at n=8: even a perfect 8/8 against a 0.875 null gives p = 0.34. The QUALIFIED verdict was the right call and the Wilson interval [0.36, 0.89] is the honest summary - the true relock rate could be anywhere from a coin flip to near-certain.

claims.headline: Chase-hold does not transfer to REGROUND: 0/10
claims.independence_note: ALL TEN TRIALS FAIL IDENTICALLY: in_fov spans 0.2279-0.2305, carry_frames 464-474, carry_px_err_mean 8.6 in every run, relock_on empty in all ten. One deterministic failure mode observed ten times.
claims.caveats: n=10 parece la muestra más fuerte de la Parte IV y es la más débil. Informar del intervalo Wilson sobre 0/10 ([0, 0.28]) implicaría diez extracciones independientes; hubo una. La afirmación correcta es mecanicista — la palanca no se aplica a esta ruta de código — y está bien respaldada por las trazas idénticas.
claims.caveats_en: n=10 looks like the strongest Part IV sample and is the weakest. Reporting the Wilson interval on 0/10 ([0, 0.28]) would imply ten independent draws; there was one. The correct claim is mechanistic - the lever does not apply to this code path - and it is well supported by the identical traces.

claims.headline: The mask-keyed relock closes the identity hole: 3/3 with the control reproducing the hole 0/1
claims.independence_note: three unseeded repeats of ONE decoy scenario at one speed; final_d_true is 0.21/0.21/0.22 m - effectively the same trajectory three times
claims.caveats: 3/3 tiene una cota inferior de Wilson de en torno a 0.44 incluso si los tres fueran independientes, y no lo son. E15 falló después en esa misma pata de regresión 0/1, lo que obligó a ejecutar E16 para zanjarlo - y E16 encontró 6/8, es decir, el arreglo es real pero NO determinista. E14 por sí solo lo sobrevaloró.
claims.caveats_en: 3/3 has a Wilson lower bound of about 0.44 even if the three were independent, and they are not. E15 then failed the same regression leg 0/1, which E16 had to be run to settle - and E16 found 6/8, i.e. the fix is real but NOT deterministic. E14 alone overstated it.

claims.headline: A colour gate does not prevent the decoy lock: 0/3
claims.independence_note: id_switch_s is 4.16/4.16/4.17 s and carry_frames 551/551/553 - one trajectory, three times
claims.caveats: Un 0/3 determinista. Afirmación mecanicista, no probabilística: la puerta nunca se dispara en este escenario. Que los tres tramos de regresión pasen 3/3 es lo que hace interpretable el resultado negativo: el cambio estaba activo y no hizo nada.
claims.caveats_en: A deterministic 0/3. Mechanistic claim, not probabilistic: the gate never fires on this scenario. The three regression legs passing 3/3 is what makes the negative interpretable - the change was live and did nothing.

claims.headline: Commanded retarget to a distractor succeeds 3/3 on all seven criteria
claims.independence_note: id_switch_s 22.28/22.32/22.36 and final_d_true 4.18/4.19/4.19 - three near-identical trajectories. Differing frame counts reflect wall-clock jitter, not scenario variation.
claims.caveats: Una demostración de capacidad sobre un único escenario. La prueba de humo de color (blanco 10/10, azul 10/10) es una pata distinta y mejor respaldada porque varía la entrada en lugar de repetir la ejecución.
claims.caveats_en: A capability demonstration on one scenario. The colour smoke test (white 10/10, blue 10/10) is a separate and better-supported leg because it varies the input rather than repeating the run.

claims.headline: Real follow ceiling is 2.5 m/s: 3/3 at 2.5, 0/2 at 3.0
claims.independence_note: The triplets are near-byte-identical: s2.0a/b/c share first_lock 2.30 and 7 attempts; s3.0a/b have IDENTICAL in_fov 0.0521. Four speed settings, not nine trials.
claims.caveats: Un barrido de búsqueda de umbral, y las repeticiones deterministas son en realidad una VIRTUD aquí: establecen que la frontera entre 2.5 y 3.0 es una propiedad del controlador y no de la extracción. Presentarlo como '3/3 frente a 0/2' invita a una prueba que carecería de sentido; presentarlo como un techo medido con cuatro configuraciones es lo correcto.
claims.caveats_en: A threshold-finding sweep, and the deterministic repeats are actually a VIRTUE here: they establish that the boundary between 2.5 and 3.0 is a property of the controller and not of the draw. Presenting it as '3/3 vs 0/2' invites a test that would be meaningless; presenting it as a measured ceiling with four settings is correct.

claims.headline: Warm-start acquire lands 5/6 where cold lands 1/6, matching the GT-seed oracle exactly
claims.independence_note: n=2 reps are deterministic (greedy decode, fixed-cadence catch-up); every r1/r2 pair agrees. 12 rows, 6 clips.
claims.caveats: p = 0.125. El primer YES de la Parte V no es estadísticamente significativo: n=6 exige que se inviertan los seis pares y se invirtieron cuatro. La condición pre-registrada de superconjunto (el conjunto de PASS de WARM contiene el de COLD) es una comprobación estructural más fuerte que el recuento y se cumplió: eso, más la coincidencia exacta con el oráculo, es la forma defendible de la afirmación. P5.2 es lo que realmente lo certifica.
claims.caveats_en: p = 0.125. The first Part V YES is not statistically significant: n=6 requires all six pairs to flip and four did. The pre-registered superset condition (WARM's PASS set contains COLD's) is a stronger structural check than the count and it held - that, plus the exact match with the oracle, is the defensible form of the claim. P5.2 is what actually certifies it.

claims.headline: Warm-start generalises past cars: WARM 21/25 vs COLD 5/25 over 5 categories
claims.independence_note: n=1 per cell, no rep pseudo-replication. 25 distinct UAV123 sequences, but car3/car3_s and person1/person1_s share source video, and 6 clips are re-used from P5.1 - so P5.1 and P5.2a are not independent confirmations of each other.
claims.caveats: EL RESULTADO CON MÁS POTENCIA ESTADÍSTICA DE LA PARTE V Y CON EL QUE LA TESIS DEBERÍA ABRIR. b=16, c=0, McNemar exacto p = 3.05e-05, y sobrevive a la corrección de Holm en toda la familia. 16 clips vuelcan de fallo a éxito y ninguno vuelca de vuelta. Esta es la afirmación del warm-start, debidamente certificada.
claims.caveats_en: THE BEST-POWERED RESULT IN PART V AND THE ONE THE THESIS SHOULD LEAD WITH. b=16, c=0, exact McNemar p = 3.05e-05, and it survives Holm correction across the whole family. 16 clips flip from fail to pass and not one flips back. This is the warm-start claim, properly certified.

claims.headline: The WARM-COLD gap is FLAT in on-screen target speed (Spearman rho = -0.06)
claims.independence_note: same 25-clip caveats as P5.2a, plus heavy ties in speed_pct_s (2.04 appears 3x, 7.37 3x, 4.21 2x) which a rank correlation handles but which cut the effective spread
claims.caveats: Una hipótesis direccional pre-registrada (se exigía rho > 0) que salió en rho = -0.06, cuyo p bilateral con n=25 ronda 0.78 - es decir, ninguna asociación en absoluto, no una débil. Este es un negativo genuino e IMPORTA: dice que la ganancia del warm-start es la eliminación del retardo de entrega, no compensación de movimiento. Un nulo que remodela el mecanismo vale más que la mayoría de los positivos de aquí.
claims.caveats_en: A pre-registered directional hypothesis (rho > 0 required) that came out at rho = -0.06, whose two-sided p at n=25 is around 0.78 - i.e. no association whatsoever, not a weak one. This is a genuine negative and it MATTERS: it says the warm-start win is delivery-lag removal, not motion compensation. A null that reshapes the mechanism is worth more than most of the positives here.

claims.headline: Select-on-command scores WSEL 3/5, SWAP 2/5 against a 4/5 gate
claims.independence_note: the unit is a CELL = (clip, prompt-onset frame), and the 5 cells come from only FOUR distinct UAV123 sequences - car10 appears twice at two onsets
claims.caveats: LA PUERTA PRE-REGISTRADA ERA ESTADÍSTICAMENTE INALCANZABLE. Frente a una hipótesis nula de 0.8, incluso un 5/5 perfecto da p = 0.33, de modo que ningún resultado posible de este diseño podría haber superado 4/5 en ningún sentido inferencial. El NO es una parada de ingeniería legítima; no es evidencia de que el select-on-command no funcione.
claims.caveats_en: THE PRE-REGISTERED GATE WAS STATISTICALLY UNREACHABLE. Against a 0.8 null even a perfect 5/5 gives p = 0.33, so no possible outcome of this design could have cleared 4/5 in any inferential sense. The NO is a legitimate engineering stop; it is not evidence that select-on-command does not work.

claims.headline: ROI-constrained select scores VSEL 3/5, VSWP 3/5; acquire drops 4.9 s -> 2.08 s
claims.independence_note: same 5 cells from 4 sequences as P5.3, and the SAME cells - so P5.3 and P5.4 are one sample measured twice, not two experiments
claims.caveats: El README revela un SESGO DE PILOTO: 3 de las 5 escenas del veredicto se usaron en el piloto. Combinada con el umbral inalcanzable, esta celda no informa nada sobre la exactitud del select. La pata de LATENCIA (4.9 s -> 2.08 s) es determinista y se sostiene por sí sola.
claims.caveats_en: The README discloses a PILOT BIAS: 3 of the 5 verdict scenes were used in the pilot. Combined with the unreachable gate this cell is uninformative about select accuracy. The LATENCY leg (4.9 s -> 2.08 s) is deterministic and stands on its own.

claims.headline: Maintained-candidate select reaches WSEL 4/5 but SWAP 3/5
claims.independence_note: 6 cells from FOUR sequences; the newly-added gating cell car9:560 is cut from the same video as car9:300
claims.caveats: Tercer NO de select consecutivo sobre un diseño cuya puerta ningún resultado podía superar. El contenido genuinamente informativo es diagnóstico, no inferencial: el re-anclaje en reposo se disparó y fue aceptado en las 16 celdas, y dos fallos NO_MATCH por deriva de carry sobrevivieron a ello. Eso es un mecanismo, y es lo que motivó el cambio del contrato de entrega.
claims.caveats_en: Third consecutive select NO on a design whose gate no outcome could clear. The genuinely informative content is diagnostic, not inferential: the idle re-anchor fired and was accepted on all 16 cells, and two carry-drift NO_MATCH failures survived it. That is a mechanism, and it is what motivated the delivery-contract change.

claims.headline: The on-demand Gazebo scene generator delivers a clean 12-cell deterministic GT bank
claims.independence_note: 16 runs over 15 distinct seeds - seed101_A and seed101_D are one seed run twice for the determinism check and their purity/frag values are identical to 4 dp
claims.caveats: Una puerta de construcción, tratada correctamente como tal. 12/12 tiene un intervalo de Wilson de [0.76, 1.0]: el generador es bueno, no está demostrado que sea perfecto. Las 12 celdas proceden de un único generador con un único conjunto de activos, de modo que esto mide el artefacto, no una población de escenas.
claims.caveats_en: A build gate, correctly treated as one. 12/12 has a Wilson interval of [0.76, 1.0] - the generator is good, not proven perfect. All 12 cells come from one generator with one asset set, so this measures the artifact, not a scene population.

claims.headline: Direct-delivery and re-ground contracts tie perfectly on the sim bank: DD 24/24 vs RG 24/24
claims.independence_note: 24 cells = 12 clips x 2 phrase legs over the SAME rendered pixels with the carry pass cached and shared per clip. n_effective is 12 at most.
claims.caveats: CERO pares discordantes: McNemar queda INDEFINIDO, no 1.0. Esta campaña no encontró que los brazos fueran iguales; no ejecutó ninguna prueba. Ambos brazos están en el techo, de modo que el diseño no tenía margen para separar nada — que es exactamente lo que dice el diagnóstico 'scene-bound' del registro, y la estadística coincide.
claims.caveats_en: ZERO discordant pairs: McNemar is UNDEFINED, not 1.0. This campaign did not find the arms equal; it ran no test. Both arms are at ceiling, so the design had no room to separate anything - which is exactly what the ledger's 'scene-bound' diagnosis says, and the statistics agree.

claims.headline: Recalibrated admission floors take the same generator from 3/12 to 12/12 bank cells
claims.independence_note: NOT a paired re-measurement: only 6 of 12 seeds are shared with P5.11 and the other 6 are new. Fisher is the correct test precisely because the item sets differ.
claims.caveats: EL CAVEAT MÁS IMPORTANTE DEL ARCO DE SIMULACIÓN DE LA PARTE V. La mejora es en parte DEFINICIONAL: los suelos (G6c 60 -> 40, G8b 0.55 -> 0.40) se recalibraron a partir de la propia población registrada de P5.11. Bajar un umbral y luego informar de que más celdas lo superan no es un efecto. Lo que SÍ es legítimo es que los suelos se congelaron ANTES de la ejecución y que 6 semillas no vistas también lo superaron, y que el delta de predicción de frame limpio offline fue 0 en las 12. Preséntese como una corrección de calibrado, nunca como una mejora de 4x.
claims.caveats_en: THE MOST IMPORTANT CAVEAT IN PART V's SIM ARC. The improvement is partly DEFINITIONAL: the floors (G6c 60 -> 40, G8b 0.55 -> 0.40) were recalibrated from P5.11's own recorded population. Lowering a threshold and then reporting that more cells clear it is not an effect. What IS legitimate is that the floors were frozen BEFORE the run and 6 unseen seeds also cleared, and that the offline clear-frame prediction delta was 0 on all 12. Present it as a calibration correction, never as a 4x improvement.

claims.headline: Contracts tie again on designed crossings: DD 24/24 vs RG 23/24
claims.independence_note: 12 clips x 2 legs over identical pixels; DD and RG are scored from the SAME within-cell SAM2 carry, so the arms are coupled by construction
claims.caveats: UN solo par discordante: p = 1.0 bilateral. El SEP_MARGIN pre-registrado de 4 estaba él mismo por debajo del efecto mínimo detectable: alcanzar alfa requería 6 discordantes en un solo sentido. Y DD está en 24/24, de modo que el rango observable de DD-RG queda acotado por arriba por el único fallo de RG. «Los contratos son equivalentes» no está respaldado; «este diseño no tenía potencia para distinguirlos», sí.
claims.caveats_en: ONE discordant pair: p = 1.0 two-sided. The pre-registered SEP_MARGIN of 4 was itself below the minimum detectable effect - reaching alpha needed 6 one-way discordants. And DD sits at 24/24, so the observable range of DD-RG is bounded above by RG's single failure. 'The contracts are equivalent' is not supported; 'this design had no power to distinguish them' is.

claims.headline: First real-video select YES: direct delivery scores WSEL 5/5 at acquire 0.00 s vs 4.51 s
claims.independence_note: the 5 gating scenes are cut from only THREE distinct UAV123 clips (car10 x2, car9 x2, car7 x1). Scenes were also chosen BECAUSE they were P5.5 failure cells - an adversarial, non-representative sample.
claims.caveats: 5/5 frente a una hipótesis nula de 0.8 da p = 0.33 — el umbral no pudo superarse inferencialmente con esta n. P5.18 volvió a ejecutar después esta afirmación con n=26 y encontró una tasa WSEL real cercana a 0.85, coherente con 5/5 y, con razón, menos llamativa. Cítese P5.18, no P5.14.
claims.caveats_en: 5/5 against a 0.8 null gives p = 0.33 - the gate could not be cleared inferentially at this n. P5.18 later re-ran this claim at n=26 and found the true WSEL rate near 0.85, which is consistent with 5/5 and correctly less exciting. Cite P5.18, not P5.14.

claims.headline: Strengthened SWAP scores 4/5 under direct delivery
claims.independence_note: same 3 source clips; the SWAP and WSEL legs of a scene share the video and the carry
claims.caveats: 4/5 frente a 0.8 es p = 0.74 - literalmente lo que predice la hipótesis nula. P5.18 halló la tasa real de SWAP en 0.65 (17/26), así que esta celda fue optimismo de n pequeño y el propio trabajo posterior del repositorio lo dice.
claims.caveats_en: 4/5 against 0.8 is p = 0.74 - literally what the null predicts. P5.18 found the true SWAP rate at 0.65 (17/26), so this cell was small-n optimism and the repo's own later work says so.

claims.headline: The shadow re-ground contract disagrees with direct delivery on 3 of 10 real gating cells
claims.independence_note: 10 gating cells from 3 source clips
claims.caveats: p = 0.25. Los tres desacuerdos son RG devolviendo NO_MATCH: no llegó a seleccionar en absoluto, en lugar de seleccionar de otro modo. Esa asimetría es más informativa que el recuento: sobre imagen real el contrato de re-grounding no se limita a perder, se abstiene. Contrástese con los bancos de simulación (P5.10/13/17), donde RG consigue el grounding de casi todo: la diferencia es la fragilidad ante imagen real.
claims.caveats_en: p = 0.25. All three disagreements are RG returning NO_MATCH - it failed to select at all, rather than selecting differently. That asymmetry is more informative than the count: on real imagery the re-ground contract does not merely lose, it abstains. Contrast with the sim banks (P5.10/13/17) where RG grounds nearly everything - the difference is real-imagery fragility.

claims.headline: An unmaintained warm carry survives a 24 s idle window on 24/25 clips
claims.independence_note: 25 distinct UAV123 clips, one observation each - one of the two cleanest samples in Part V
claims.caveats: 24/25 frente al suelo pre-registrado de 18/25 da un valor p exacto unilateral de 0.0016, y el intervalo Wilson es [0.80, 0.99]. ESTE ES UN RESULTADO DEBIDAMENTE CERTIFICADO y es portante: el carry no es la parte frágil, lo que redirige todo el análisis de fallos hacia la entrega y la selección.
claims.caveats_en: 24/25 against the pre-registered floor of 18/25 gives an exact one-sided p of 0.0016, and the Wilson interval is [0.80, 0.99]. THIS IS A PROPERLY CERTIFIED RESULT and it is load-bearing: the carry is not the fragile part, which redirects the whole failure analysis onto delivery and selection.

claims.headline: The deployed idle re-anchor is a net REGRESSION: PLAIN 24/25 vs MAINT 22/25 at 16 s
claims.independence_note: same 25 clips under both maintenance policies - a true pairing
claims.caveats: p = 0.625. La regresión NO está estadísticamente establecida, y la afirmación honesta es que el mantenimiento no compró nada medible mientras costaba cómputo. El mecanismo (100/100 re-anclajes aceptados sin suelo de IoU, que provocan intercambios de identidad dentro de la misma clase) es evidencia diagnóstica que un recuento de 25 clips no puede aportar, y es la razón por la que retirar la palanca seguía siendo correcto.
claims.caveats_en: p = 0.625. The regression is NOT statistically established, and the honest statement is that maintenance bought nothing measurable while costing compute. The mechanism (100/100 re-anchors accepted with no IoU floor, causing same-class identity swaps) is diagnostic evidence that a 25-clip count cannot supply, and it is why removing the lever was still correct.

claims.headline: Removing the GT seed oracle costs exactly one cell: WSEL 4/5
claims.independence_note: same 5 gating scenes from 3 source clips as P5.14
claims.caveats: El número IMPORTANTE de P5.16 no es el 4/5: es 24/24 descubrimientos del VLM en la ventana ociosa aceptados, lo que hace que el pipeline sea GT-free de extremo a extremo. Esa es una afirmación de capacidad con un denominador limpio; la tasa de select con n=5 no lo es.
claims.caveats_en: The IMPORTANT number in P5.16 is not the 4/5 - it is 24/24 idle-window VLM discoveries accepted, which makes the pipeline GT-free end-to-end. That is a capability claim with a clean denominator; the select rate at n=5 is not.

claims.headline: At real sample size the select claim holds on WSEL: 22/26
claims.independence_note: 26 gating cells; the 5 P5.16 cells are included, so P5.18 partly re-measures rather than replicates - the 21 NEW cells give WSEL 18/21
claims.caveats: 22/26 = 0.846 frente a una barra de 0.8: p exacto = 0.37, de modo que se supera DESCRIPTIVAMENTE pero no inferencialmente. El intervalo Wilson [0.67, 0.94] contiene el umbral. La frase correcta es 'coherente con la tasa pre-registrada', no 'la supera'.
claims.caveats_en: 22/26 = 0.846 against a 0.8 bar: exact p = 0.37, so it clears DESCRIPTIVELY but not inferentially. The Wilson interval [0.67, 0.94] contains the gate. The right sentence is 'consistent with the pre-registered rate', not 'exceeds it'.

claims.headline: At real sample size the strengthened SWAP MISSES: 17/26 = 0.65
claims.independence_note: same 26 cells; recomputed independently from the 54 committed results.json and matching the frozen baseline dict exactly
claims.caveats: EL RESULTADO MÁS VALIOSO DEL RE-ANÁLISIS ESTADÍSTICO. En las 5 celdas compartidas, P5.18 reproduce P5.16 EXACTAMENTE (4/5, cero inversiones); todo el vuelco procede de las 21 celdas nuevas, donde SWAP es 13/21 = 0.62. Esta es una demostración directa y medida de que los veredictos de n pequeño eran optimistas - y es el repositorio detectando su propio error, que es la forma más fuerte que la tesis puede presentar.
claims.caveats_en: THE MOST VALUABLE RESULT IN THE STATISTICAL RE-ANALYSIS. On the 5 shared cells P5.18 reproduces P5.16 EXACTLY (4/5, zero flips); the entire overturn comes from the 21 new cells, where SWAP is 13/21 = 0.62. This is a direct, measured demonstration that the small-n verdicts were optimistic - and it is the repo catching its own error, which is the strongest form the thesis can present.

claims.headline: Aligned dedup plus bounded grace delivery flips SWAP 17/26 -> 20/26 with zero WSEL regression
claims.independence_note: same 26 gating cells under both configurations - a clean pairing, the best-designed comparison in late Part V
claims.caveats: b=3, c=0, p = 0.25. EL YES JUSTO EN LA BARRA NO ES SIGNIFICATIVO. Tres celdas pasan de fallo a acierto y ninguna vuelve atrás, que es la FORMA correcta para un arreglo real, pero tres es la mitad de los seis cambios en un solo sentido que alfa exigiría con esta n. El mecanismo de apoyo es fuerte (el guardián de P5.18 estaba desalineado respecto al fotograma y se disparó 0/108 veces; la entrega de gracia cuesta 0.37-0.60 s frente a 4.68 s en frío) y P5.20 reprodujo de forma independiente el brazo T celda por celda. Preséntese así: una mejora explicada mecánicamente y del signo correcto, todavía no certificada.
claims.caveats_en: b=3, c=0, p = 0.25. THE BAR-EXACT YES IS NOT SIGNIFICANT. Three cells flip fail-to-pass and none flip back, which is the right SHAPE for a real fix, but three is half of the six one-way flips alpha would require at this n. The supporting mechanism is strong (P5.18's guard was frame-misaligned and fired 0/108 times; grace delivery costs 0.37-0.60 s against 4.68 s cold) and P5.20 independently reproduced arm T cell-for-cell. Present as: a mechanically-explained improvement of the right sign, not yet certified.

claims.headline: The rescue causes zero WSEL regression: 22/26 -> 22/26, no cell changes
claims.independence_note: same 26 cells under both configurations
claims.caveats: Cero pares discordantes, así que no existe prueba alguna. Aquí el empate es el resultado DESEADO y su interpretación es segura de un modo en que la de P5.10 no lo es: ni una sola de las 26 celdas cambió de estado, lo que acota estrechamente cualquier regresión incluso sin un valor p. Enúnciese como 'ninguna celda cambió', nunca como 'demostrado inocuo'.
claims.caveats_en: Zero discordant pairs, so no test exists. Here the tie is the DESIRED outcome and its interpretation is safe in a way P5.10's is not: not one of 26 cells changed state, which bounds any regression tightly even without a p-value. State it as 'no cell changed', never as 'proved harmless'.

claims.headline: The grace delivery fires 4 times and is right twice
claims.independence_note: 4 firings, 3 on gating cells
claims.caveats: El intervalo de Wilson sobre 2/4 es [0.15, 0.85] - esta medición no aporta esencialmente ninguna información sobre la precisión real. Se registra como un residuo abierto y ese es el único uso defendible. Lo que importa cualitativamente es el MODO DE FALLO: los disparos erróneos entregan una caja con confianza en lugar de abstenerse, que es la dirección peligrosa para un sistema de cara al operador.
claims.caveats_en: The Wilson interval on 2/4 is [0.15, 0.85] - this measurement carries essentially no information about the true precision. It is recorded as an open residual and that is the only defensible use. What matters qualitatively is the FAILURE MODE: the wrong firings deliver a confident box instead of abstaining, which is the dangerous direction for an operator-facing system.

claims.headline: A bigger SAM2 (hiera-small, 46M) recovers zero select failures and regresses one
claims.independence_note: 52 pairs = 26 cells x 2 legs; the two legs of a cell share the video and the carry, so n_effective is 26
claims.caveats: b=0, c=1: p = 1.0. No es evidencia de que la capacidad no ayude, es evidencia de que este diseño no vio efecto alguno en ninguna dirección. Lo que hace defendible lo de «palanca muerta» no es el recuento sino el MECANISMO: el mismo bloqueo de deriva de la familia de coches aparece en ambos brazos, de modo que los fallos no están limitados por la capacidad. Una n mayor tendría que justificarse con un mecanismo plausible, y ninguno sobrevive.
claims.caveats_en: b=0, c=1: p = 1.0. Not evidence that capacity does not help - evidence that this design saw no effect either way. What makes 'dead lever' defensible is not the count but the MECHANISM: the same car-family drift block appears in both arms, so the failures are not capacity-limited. A larger n would have to be justified by a plausible mechanism, and none survives.

claims.headline: P5.20's control arm reproduces P5.19 cell-for-cell: zero flips across 52 pairs
claims.independence_note: same 26 cells re-run in a separate campaign
claims.caveats: Cero discordantes, así que formalmente no hay prueba — pero este es el 'indefinido' más valioso del registro. Una re-ejecución independiente que reproduce las 52 celdas exactamente establece que la medición de P5.19 es estable y no una extracción afortunada. Certifica la REPETIBILIDAD, que es una propiedad distinta de la significación y que la tesis debería reclamar explícitamente porque la mayoría de las campañas de aquí no pueden.
claims.caveats_en: Zero discordants, so formally no test - but this is the most valuable 'undefined' in the registry. An independent re-run reproducing all 52 cells exactly establishes that the P5.19 measurement is stable and not a lucky draw. It certifies REPEATABILITY, which is a different property from significance and one the thesis should claim explicitly because most campaigns here cannot.

claims.headline: Third contract tie at n=56 with the P5.13 defect provably fixed: DD 56/56 vs RG 55/56
claims.independence_note: 56 cells = 28 procedurally-generated scenes x 2 phrase legs over identical renders. The 28 scenes are seed-varied draws from ONE generator with one town and one asset set - exchangeable within a narrow distribution, not a sample of a target population.
claims.caveats: LA DEMOSTRACIÓN MÁS CLARA DEL REPOSITORIO DE QUE n NO ERA LA RESTRICCIÓN VINCULANTE. Pasar de 24 a 56 celdas no aumentó la potencia, porque lo que cayó fue la TASA de fallo en vez de aparecer el efecto: b=1, c=0, p=1.0, exactamente igual que con n=24. El SEP_MARGIN pre-registrado de 7 exigía que RG fallara 7 celdas; RG falló 1 en toda la matriz. La conclusión correcta es que el simulador renderiza demasiado limpio para separar los contratos, lo cual es una afirmación sobre el instrumento, no sobre la hipótesis.
claims.caveats_en: THE CLEAREST DEMONSTRATION IN THE REPOSITORY THAT n WAS NOT THE BINDING CONSTRAINT. Going from 24 to 56 cells did not increase power, because the failure RATE fell rather than the effect appearing: b=1, c=0, p=1.0, exactly as at n=24. The pre-registered SEP_MARGIN of 7 needed RG to fail 7 cells; RG failed 1 in the whole matrix. The correct conclusion is that the simulator renders too cleanly to separate the contracts, which is a statement about the instrument, not the hypothesis.

claims.headline: The closed-loop flight rig passes its capability gate; the ByteTrack re-find bug is found and fixed (px_err 64.7 -> 36.0)
claims.independence_note: a capability gate on one rig, not a sampled measurement
claims.caveats: n=1 es CORRECTO aquí y la tesis debería decir por qué: una puerta de capacidad pregunta «¿puede este montaje cerrar el lazo siquiera?», y una sola demostración lo responde. La mejora de px_err 64.7 -> 36.0 es un antes/después sobre un único vuelo y no debe citarse como error esperado. La afirmación retirada de px_err de Phase-C Branch-1 es el ejemplo aleccionador.
claims.caveats_en: n=1 is CORRECT here and the thesis should say why: a capability gate asks 'can this rig close the loop at all', and one demonstration answers it. The px_err improvement 64.7 -> 36.0 is a before/after on one flight and must not be quoted as an expected error. The withdrawn Phase-C Branch-1 px_err claim is the cautionary example.

claims.headline: CARLA 0.9.16 replaces Gazebo as the pose-slaved renderer: 48.1 Hz with 40 vehicles over a live GUIDED flight
claims.independence_note: one flight, one town, one traffic density
claims.caveats: Una afirmación de capacidad medida una sola vez, correctamente. EL ÚNICO NÚMERO QUE NO DEBE CITARSE: slave_err = 0.000 m es vacuo — la cámara libre de CARLA es un actor cinemático, de modo que get_transform() devuelve exactamente lo que se le acaba de pasar a set_transform(). No mide nada sobre la fidelidad del pose-slaving.
claims.caveats_en: A capability claim measured once, correctly. THE ONE NUMBER THAT MUST NOT BE CITED: slave_err = 0.000 m is vacuous - CARLA's free camera is a kinematic actor, so get_transform() returns exactly what set_transform() was just given. It measures nothing about pose-slaving fidelity.
